title: Insurance Claim Services Regulated-Scope Supplement — PPE Line
content:
Q. Which PPE does an Insurance Claim Services regulated-scope supplement carry?

A. The regulated PPE is taken as follows: when PPE is billable on the water job's tier and the job billed an asbestos sampling line, the PPE billed on the job; when PPE is billable on the job's tier, the job billed a lead-safe setup and no asbestos sampling line, one technician-day at the tier's PPE rate; otherwise no PPE.

Q. On which Water Damage Mitigation tiers is PPE billable?

A. On the Gray Water and Black Water tiers (Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss and - Large Loss, Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss and - Large Loss). It is not billable on Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss or - Large Loss.

Q. What does "one technician-day at the tier's PPE rate" amount to?

A. A single day of personal protective equipment for one technician at the PPE rate per technician per day of the water job's tier, as one amount, whatever the number of technicians or days billed on the job.

## Table of outcomes

| PPE billable on the water job's tier | Asbestos sampling billed | Lead-safe setup billed | PPE taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | the PPE billed on the job |
| yes | no | yes | one technician-day at the tier's PPE rate |
| yes | no | no | none |
| no | any | any | none |

*Hypothetical:* a Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss job with PPE billed at 231.00 and an asbestos sampling line takes 231.00; the same job with a lead-safe setup line and no asbestos sampling takes one technician-day at the Black Water tier's PPE rate; a Clean Water job takes no PPE.
